lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary sequence of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six observable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Centroids are distributed with higher density in the mid-lateral region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with inter-centroid spacing decreasing anteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, particularly evident in the mid-body region where blobs act as anchor nodes for the vertical luminance gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. The primary carina exhibits a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance pixels on the superior edge and a deep shadow (low luminance) along the inferior edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing distal edge of the visible pectoral fin exhibits irregular tissue loss and jagged marginal indentations, indicating significant mechanical trauma or historical amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high-density population of micro-blobs (small, low-intensity spots) that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than those found on the primary lateral flank.
